description: Defines the ItemDetails class for Point of Sale item details UI component in ERPNext, including rendering item info, handling serial/batch numbers, and user interactions.

classes.name: erpnext.PointOfSale.ItemDetails
classes.description: Class managing the item details modal in POS, including rendering item info, serial/batch handling, and user interactions.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the ItemDetails component with wrapper, events, and settings.

methods.name: init_component
methods.description: Sets up DOM, child components, event bindings, and shortcuts.

methods.name: prepare_dom
methods.description: Creates the main container element for item details.

methods.name: init_child_components
methods.description: Initializes the HTML structure for item details, including header, display, discount, and form sections.

methods.name: compare_with_current_item
methods.description: Checks if the given item is currently being edited.

methods.name: toggle_item_details_section
methods.description: Shows or hides the item details section based on the selected item.

methods.name: validate_serial_batch_item
methods.description: Validates serial and batch numbers; removes item if invalid.

methods.name: render_dom
methods.description: Renders item name, description, image, and price.

methods.name: handle_broken_image
methods.description: Replaces broken item images with abbreviation.

methods.name: render_discount_dom
methods.description: Displays discount information if available.

methods.name: render_form
methods.description: Creates form controls for item attributes like qty, rate, serial/batch numbers.

methods.name: get_form_fields
methods.description: Determines which form fields to display based on item properties.

methods.name: make_auto_serial_selection_btn
methods.description: Adds button for auto-fetching serial numbers if applicable.

methods.name: bind_custom_control_change_event
methods.description: Binds onchange events for form controls like rate, warehouse, serial/batch numbers.

methods.name: auto_update_batch_no
methods.description: Automatically updates batch number based on selected serial numbers.

methods.name: bind_events
methods.description: Binds UI events such as auto serial fetch and close button.

methods.name: attach_shortcuts
methods.description: Sets keyboard shortcuts for closing the modal.

methods.name: bind_fields_to_numpad_fields
methods.description: Links form fields to numpad input focus.

methods.name: bind_auto_serial_fetch_event
methods.description: Handles auto-fetch serial number button click, fetching serials from server.

methods.name: toggle_component
methods.description: Shows or hides the item details component.
